arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Yumemizuki Mizuki from Genshin Impact expressing joy. The supplied explicitly approved neutral is the sole image reference. Preserve its exact identity, face, skin tone, mint-blue hair with curled ends and pink accents, pink-lilac eyes, pointed ears, elaborate headpiece and bows, pink kimono, white apron, purple swirl designs, gold spiral ornaments, detached long sleeves, thigh accessory, socks and platform sandals. Match its detailed polished anime illustration style. Preserve the approved neutral's petite Medium Female build, compact torso and natural limb lengths without elongation or turning her into a chibi.
Character acting: retain her serene, warmly attentive demeanor while letting the emotion show clearly. A bright, heartfelt smile with happily crinkled open eyes. Lean slightly toward the viewer with a lively head tilt, right hand lifted beside the shoulder in a small friendly greeting, left arm relaxed outward at waist height. Let a light weight shift and lifted heel express spontaneous delight rather than repeating the neutral welcoming palm-up pose. Change body language, stance and gesture for this emotion rather than changing only the face.
Hand rendering: draw complete natural human hands, each with a softly shaped palm, four fingers and a separate shorter opposable thumb. Use coherent knuckles and relaxed bends appropriate to the gesture. Let naturally overlapping digits remain overlapped rather than forcing them all into view. Keep the hands spatially separate and clearly outlined, with a visible gap from nearby fabric wherever the gesture does not call for contact. Keep exactly two coherent legs and feet in a simple balanced stance. Hair and heavy hanging panels follow the pose naturally with gravity; patterns and ornaments turn with the surfaces they belong to. Preserve the complete established outfit and ordinary pupils. No heart pupils or floating hearts. Both hands are empty; no tray, cup, food, drink, tool or prop.
Show the complete silhouette including hair, headwear, hands, sleeves, ornaments and shoes, using roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Genuinely transparent background with clear alpha outside the character. No scenery, backdrop, floor, reflections, ground shadow, effects, text, labels, UI, watermark or additional characters.
